title: Common Issues
content:
Sensor Won’t Connect to Wi-Fi Symptoms: LED stays blue flashing, can’t complete setup
Solutions:
Ensure you’re using a 2.4GHz network (not 5GHz) Move closer to your Wi-Fi router Check that your Wi-Fi password is correct Restart your router and try again Many dual-band routers broadcast both frequencies with the same name. Try temporarily disabling 5GHz during setup. False Presence Detection Symptoms: Sensor reports presence when room is empty
Solutions:
Check for moving objects (fans, curtains, pets) Reduce sensitivity in app settings Ensure sensor isn’t pointing at windows or reflective surfaces Run manual calibration with room empty No Presence Detection Symptoms: Sensor doesn’t detect when someone is present
Solutions:
Verify power connection (LED should be solid blue) Check sensor placement and angle Increase sensitivity in app settings Run manual calibration Sensor Offline in App Symptoms: App shows “Offline” or “Disconnected”
Solutions:
Check power connection Verify Wi-Fi network is working Restart the sensor by unplugging for 10 seconds Check router for IP address conflicts Factory Reset If all else fails, perform a factory reset:
Press and hold the reset button for 10 seconds LED will flash red then blue Reconfigure using the app Factory reset erases all settings. You’ll need to set up the device again from scratch.

title: Setup
description: Configure your Bed Presence Sensor for optimal performance
content:
Initial Setup Power on the sensor using the included USB-C adapter Open the OpticWorks app on your phone Tap “Add Device” and select “Bed Presence Sensor” Follow the in-app instructions to connect to Wi-Fi Placement For bed monitoring, position the sensor:
Under the bed or on a nightstand Pointed toward the center of the mattress 50-100cm from the edge of the bed The sensor works through mattresses and bedding. No direct line of sight to the person is required. Wi-Fi Connection Ensure your phone is on the same network The sensor will broadcast a setup network (OpticWorks-XXXX) Connect and enter your home Wi-Fi credentials The sensor will reboot and connect automatically LED Status LED Color Meaning Blue flashing Starting up Blue solid Connected, idle Green pulse Presence detected Red flashing Error or offline

title: Unboxing
description: What's included in your OpticWorks package
content:
What’s in the Box Your OpticWorks package includes everything you need to get started:
Presence Sensor - The main sensing unit Power Adapter - USB-C power supply (5V/2A) Mounting Hardware - Screws and adhesive pad for installation Quick Start Guide - Printed setup instructions Before You Begin Check that all items are present Inspect the sensor for any damage Download the OpticWorks app (iOS/Android) Ensure you have a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi network available The sensor requires a 2.4GHz Wi-Fi connection. 5GHz networks are not supported for initial setup.

title: Calibration
description: Fine-tune your sensor for accurate detection
content:
Why Calibrate? Calibration helps the sensor understand your specific environment:
Room size and shape Bed position and height Typical movements vs. presence Automatic Calibration The sensor automatically calibrates during the first 24 hours:
Leave the room empty for 30 minutes after setup The sensor will establish a baseline Normal use will refine detection over time Manual Calibration If detection is inaccurate, you can trigger manual calibration:
Open the OpticWorks app Go to Device Settings → Calibration Select Start Calibration Follow the on-screen prompts: Empty room for 2 minutes Lie in bed for 2 minutes Exit the room Sensitivity Adjustment Fine-tune detection sensitivity in the app:
High - Detects subtle movements (may increase false positives) Medium - Balanced setting (recommended) Low - Requires significant presence (fewer false triggers) After changing sensitivity, allow 24 hours for the sensor to re-learn patterns.

title: Installation
description: Physical setup and placement of your sensor
content:
Choosing a Location For optimal performance, place your sensor:
1-2 meters from the monitoring area Elevated position (1-1.5m from floor) Clear line of sight to the target area Away from heat sources and direct sunlight Mounting Options Wall Mount Use the included screws or adhesive pad Position the sensor at a 15-30° downward angle Ensure the USB-C port is accessible Tabletop Placement Place on a stable, flat surface Use the rubber feet to prevent sliding Angle toward the monitoring area Power Connection Connect the USB-C cable to the sensor Plug the power adapter into a wall outlet The LED will flash blue during startup Do not use extension cords or power strips that may cause voltage fluctuations.
